rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a book or other printed work published again.

example.english: This book is so popular that the publisher has issued a reprint.
example.traditional: 呢本書咁受歡迎，出版社已經再版喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 gam3 sau6 fun1 jing4 ceot1 baan2 se5 ji5 ging1 zoi3 baan2 laa3
